response.sql: SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, AVG(bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) AS diff_from_overall FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) ORDER BY (AVG(bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes)) IS NULL, diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average bandwidth usage is the mean of bandusagepct across all telescope records (non-null values), so stations with more telescopes carry more weight.
Stations whose telescopes all have NULL bandusagepct have a NULL average and are dropped by the strictly-greater-than filter.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-station averages rather than the mean over all telescope records.
alternatives.sql: WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), ov AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS overall FROM st) SELECT st.observstation, st.avg_bw AS avg_bandwidth_usage, st.avg_bw - ov.overall AS diff_from_overall FROM st, ov WHERE st.avg_bw > ov.overall ORDER BY (st.avg_bw - ov.overall) IS NULL, diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10
